description.message: AniWebScale enhances anime video in real time using Anime4K, WebGPU and an optional local Windows renderer.

modeAaOption.message: Anime4K A+A - Strong 2-pass restore + up to 4x

modeBbOption.message: Anime4K B+B - Strong soft restore + up to 4x

modeCaOption.message: Anime4K C+A - Denoise, restore + up to 4x

modeCnnOption.message: Anime4K CNN 2x - Sharp neural upscale (GPU: medium)

modeAcNetOption.message: ACNet F8B4 2x - Fast lightweight upscale (GPU: very light)

modeArNetOption.message: ARNet F8B8 2x - Strong detail recovery (GPU: balanced)

modeOffDescription.message: Disables image enhancement. Frame generation can still be enabled separately.

modeADescription.message: Restores line detail, then applies Anime4K CNN upscaling. The balanced default for most anime.

modeBDescription.message: Uses softer restoration before Anime4K CNN upscaling to reduce ringing on blurry or compressed video.

modeCDescription.message: Denoises and upscales in one Anime4K CNN pass. Best suited to visibly noisy animation.

modeAaDescription.message: Runs the Anime4K A restoration chain twice for stronger detail and up to 4x scaling. UL is a high-end GPU profile outside the 24 FPS baseline.

modeBbDescription.message: Runs the softer Anime4K B chain twice for blurry sources and up to 4x scaling. UL is a high-end GPU profile outside the 24 FPS baseline.

modeCaDescription.message: Denoises and upscales first, then restores and can upscale again. UL is a high-end GPU profile outside the 24 FPS baseline.

modeCnnDescription.message: Official Anime4K CNN at a fixed 2x scale. Produces a sharp result; Quality changes model size and GPU load.

modeArtCnnDescription.message: Fixed 2x GLSL network for reconstructing anime line art and natural detail at real-time speed.

modeAcNetDescription.message: Small fixed 2x GLSL network that prioritizes speed and very low GPU load over maximum detail recovery.

modeArNetDescription.message: Deeper fixed 2x GLSL network with stronger detail recovery than ACNet at a higher, balanced GPU load.

frameMotion2xDetailed.message: Generate a motion-aware intermediate frame for 2x frame rate.

frameMotion2xEvenOff.message: Motion-aware 2x, even while enhancement is off.

termsS1Text.message: AniWebScale is a free browser extension for local, real-time enhancement of video rendering using WebGPU and an optional Windows native renderer. All features (Anime4K presets, AI upscaling, native renderer, frame generation) are available free of charge and without an account.

termsS2Text.message: AniWebScale enhances video rendering locally. Actual performance depends on browser, Windows version, GPU, drivers, source material and website, among other factors. Protected streams may prevent capture; AniWebScale does not bypass DRM.

termsS3Text.message: Since the extension is provided free of charge, no paid contract is formed. No payment data, accounts or billing information is processed.

termsS4Text.message: The extension and included open-source components (Anime4K, ArtCNN, ACNet, ARNet, Magpie-related shaders) remain under their respective licenses. Use must comply with applicable store policies and law. Circumventing technical protection measures of content providers is prohibited.

termsS5Text.message: Updates may be required for security, compatibility or functionality reasons. Short outages due to maintenance or third parties are possible. Statutory warranty and defect rights remain unaffected.

termsS6Text.message: Liability is governed by statutory provisions. No specific availability or degree of result is guaranteed for free software.

privacyS2Text.message: When you visit the site, the hosting provider processes technical connection data, in particular IP address, timestamp, browser/device information, requested URL and response status. The purposes are delivery, stability and attack prevention; the legal basis is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR. AniWebScale does not use any advertising, analytics or profiling trackers. Application errors contain a support ID but no passwords, payment card data or video frames.

privacyS3Text.message: AniWebScale is completely free and requires no account, no registration and no payment. No email addresses, passwords, customer data or billing data is collected. There is no pro license and no Stripe integration.

privacyS4Text.message: Video processing, WebGPU models and the optional Windows native renderer run exclusively locally on the device. Video frames, visited pages and playback history are not transmitted to us. Settings, presets, theme and native site permissions are stored in chrome.storage.local or the corresponding local Firefox storage. No server communication is required for the extension to function.

privacyS5Text.message: The website does not use cookies or marketing trackers. The main page uses the system setting for light or dark design without storing it. Only after an explicit theme selection is the key aniwebscale-theme stored in localStorage to provide the desired setting. The key can be removed via the browser's website data settings.

privacyS6Text.message: As a purely static website, AniWebScale does not pass personal data on to third parties. The hosting provider processes the technical connection data mentioned in point 2 under its own responsibility.

privacyS7Text.message: Since no account data is collected, there is no specific deletion period for account data. Settings stored locally in the extension can be removed at any time by uninstalling the extension or clearing the website data in the browser.

privacyS8Text.message: Data subjects may request access, rectification, erasure, restriction and data portability, and may withdraw consent for the future. Since AniWebScale does not store personal data, this is limited to data stored locally in the browser. There is also a right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority, in particular the competent state commissioner for data protection and freedom of information.

privacyS9Text.message: AniWebScale does not collect personal data directly from data subjects via the website. In the event of material changes, we will update this declaration and the displayed version information.
